item.title: Evening Weather for Monday, September 07
item.description: Good evening! It's Monday, September 7. Time for the weather! Monday again. Let's start the week well! Today in Shanghai, it will be a little bit rainy. It will reach 29 degrees, and drop down to 23 degrees. The chance of rain is 61 percent. Pack your umbrella and your wellies! Take your raincoat with you. Splashing is allowed! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be drizzly, reaching 30 degrees. A question for you: what song would you like to hear today? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
